text: MongoDB has tools and integrations for development and management, including database management, integration, migration, and data visualization. See the following section to find the right tool for your use case. To browse tools by category, see the reference table later on this page.The following table maps common tasks to their corresponding tools:Atlas CLIManage your MongoDB Atlas deployment from the command line.MongoDB CLIAdminister Cloud Manager and Ops Manager deployments from the command line.MongoDB ShellTest queries and interact with your MongoDB database from the command line.Database ToolsExport data from one MongoDB cluster to a JSON, BSON, CSV, or TSV file and import it to another MongoDB cluster.SQL InterfaceSimplify exporting your MongoDB data to SQL-driven tools with native driver support for all deployment types.BI ConnectorConnect MongoDB to your favorite BI platforms to visualize, graph, and report on your MongoDB data.Kafka ConnectorBuild robust pipelines that stream events between applications with MongoDB and Apache Kafka.Spark ConnectorLeverage Apache Spark's libraries to analyze MongoDB data with machine learning, graph, and SQL APIs.MongoDB MCP ServerInteract with your MongoDB data and deployments from your agentic AI tools, assistants, and platforms.C# AnalyzerUnderstand and troubleshoot queries and aggregations directly inside Visual Studio and other tools.VS Code ExtensionManage your data directly within your coding environment.IntelliJ PluginBuild applications and work with your MongoDB data directly from IntelliJ IDEA.MongosyncContinuously synchronize data between MongoDB clusters in the same or hybrid environments, including Atlas, private cloud, on-premises, and at the edge.Relational MigratorMigrate data from your relational database to MongoDB.Cloud ManagerUse the hosted management platform to monitor, automate, and backup self-managed deployments.Ops ManagerDeploy, monitor, back up, and scale MongoDB on your own infrastructure.RenderConnect your Render-hosted applications to an Atlas cluster.VercelConnect your Atlas clusters to applications that you deploy using Vercel.AzureConnect your Atlas organizations with Microsoft Azure.Atlas ChartsCreate, share, and embed visualizations of MongoDB data.CompassInteract with your data through a graphical interface.
